mechanism: Hovering on/off a release row in the releases drawer table fires onMouseOverRelease/onMouseOutRelease, which invoke the highlightMarkLines/unhighlightMarkLines helpers (built by createMarkLineUpdater) against the ECharts instance held in chartRef. These helpers call echartsInstance.getOption() to fetch the chart's current option object and then drill into `series` and `series.markLine.data` to restyle the hovered release's markLine. Because the mouse events can fire asynchronously relative to the chart's own lifecycle, getOption() (or the series/markLine.data it returns) can be undefined when the chart is in a transitional state -- still loading, mid re-render, or already unmounting/disposed -- so the unguarded property access into series (and markLine.data) throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'series')`.
proposed_remedy: Guard the ECharts access chain: bail out of the mark-line updater early when getOption() returns undefined (chart not initialized or disposed) and again when the matched series or its markLine.data is missing, before touching their properties.
